title: Development of a Predictive Model of Occult Cancer After a Venous Thromboembolism Event Using Machine Learning: The CLOVER Study.
summary: CLOVER prospective VTE registry nested case-control (815 participants, 56 occult cancers) compares boosted-tree models; temporal split uses later cases as test. CatBoost gives the reported best performance. Testing: Small cancer-event count and temporal internal test; this is risk prediction, not validated population screening..
